svg.title: Different domains, testable relations
svg.desc: Three panels. A: a rat presses down the free end of a horizontal joystick handle that projects through the chamber wall; below it, a horizontal sound-frequency axis runs from lower to higher. A teal arrow labeled frequency rises while held runs rightward and stops at a release mark inside a narrow target range near the higher end. Notes: release in target range earns reward; sweep rate varied across trials. B: a goldfish task. Trained pairs, one per row: A plus, B minus; B plus, C minus; C plus, D minus; D plus, E minus, where plus marks the rewarded choice within a pair. A separate novel comparison shows B beside D without outcome signs, with B outlined and labeled controls favor B. Letters stand for visual stimuli. C: a plane with neck length increasing to the right and leg length increasing upward. Five fictional birds of identical design differ only in neck and leg length: short-short at bottom left, long neck and short legs at bottom right, short neck and long legs at top left, long-long at top right, and an intermediate bird in the center; an arrow labeled example morph runs from the bottom-left bird to the center bird. A separate note reports an fMRI finding of sixfold modulation with direction through feature space.

text.tspan: Release in target range earns reward.
Examples within a continuous feature space
